items.note: Agent flags the 2017 N+1 shortfall but recommends only 2,000 tons in 2017 rather than about 4,000 tons needed through 2017.
Agent recommends a satellite plant near the Wind Erosion Laboratory with modular 2,000-ton chillers, expansion capacity, and a 24-inch north-loop feed.
Agent phases in additional 2,000-ton chillers around 2020/2021 while retiring Chillers 5 and 6 in 2020 to maintain N+1.
Agent proposes building the 18-inch North Loop to Chem-Biochem cross-connection as part of both loop cross-connects.
Agent proposes the 18-inch Chem-Biochem to South cross-connection but leaves tunnel upsizing as 12-18 inches rather than a definitive 10-to-18-inch replacement.
Agent retires Chiller 5 in 2020 and offsets it with satellite capacity rather than replacing the 1,250-ton unit around 2023.
